title: Ben-Misandry: A Bengali Dataset and Late-Fusion Transformer Framework for Detecting Anti-Male Gender Hate

bias_targets.methodology: Creation of a taxonomy-controlled synthetic Bengali dataset (Ben-Misandry) spanning six classes of anti-male hate speech, and evaluating detection performance using classical machine learning pipelines and transformer-based classification frameworks (e.g., BanglaBERT, XLM-RoBERTa, and early/late fusion) along with SHAP-based explainability analysis.
